title: Efficient Test-Time Retrieval Augmented Generation
authors: Hailong Yin; Bin Zhu; Jingjing Chen; Chong-Wah Ngo
why_relevant: Proposes a test-time RAG framework that addresses irrelevant/noisy retrieved documents via stable organized retrieval combinations and consensus-based majority voting over candidate responses, directly targeting noisy retrieval robustness.
why_not_or_caveat: Focus is largely on efficiency; robustness to noise is a secondary motivation rather than systematic study of adversaries or conflicts.
